summary: Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting two items: (1) entry into a Second Amended and Restated Investment Advisory Agreement with its investment advisor, making administrative changes to fee calculations across unit classes; and (2) a private placement of unregistered limited partnership units to third-party investors for aggregate consideration of approximately $65 million across multiple classes (A-1a, A-1b, A-1c, I-1, S-1) at transactional NAV per unit as of March 31, 2026. The sale is part of the Fund's continuous private offering exempt from registration. No shareholder approval, board recommendation, premium, or structural event is involved. This is a routine capital raise without special-situation features.
